items.title: 5.1.1 Definition and Importance of Models (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.1.1 (PDF 127, printed 124).

blocks.text: Saada alfaaz mein, model kisi complex masle ya soorat-e-haal ko saada andaaz se dekhne ka tareeqa hai. Yeh samajhne, bayan karne ya andaza lagane (predict karne) mein madad deta hai ke cheezein kaise kaam karti hain. Jaise naqsha (map) sarkein aur mashhoor jagahein dikha kar shehar mein rasta dhoondne mein madad deta hai, waise hi model sab se aham hisson par tawajjo de kar aur ghair zaroori tafseel chhor kar masla samjhata hai.

Misal (Example): Ek student exams ki tayyari kar raha hai. Har subject ko kitna waqt dena hai, yeh tay karne ke liye woh parhai ka plan (study plan) banata hai. Yeh plan ek model hai: is mein aham subjects par tawajjo hai aur kam zaroori kaam chhor diye gaye hain, is liye schedule saada ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Asal duniya mein statistical models banane ki kya ahmiyat hai? (Short question 1)
blocks.explanation: Models data ko samajh aur pesh-goi (prediction) mein badalte hain. Yeh batate hain ke cheezein aapas mein kaise juri hain, kamai ya mausam jaise nataij ka andaza lagate hain, aur karobar, sehat, zaraat aur tehqeeq mein behtar faisle karne mein madad dete hain.

items: Model: masle ki saada shakal jo samajhne, bayan karne ya pesh-goi karne mein madad deti hai (jaise naqsha ya study plan).
